The resulting coefficients follow algebraically; the standalone checker passes symbolic identities and three numerical families.

value.rationale: The critical antipodal state is a natural nonhyperbolic boundary of the adaptive two-clock locking diagram, where ordinary stability results cannot quantify the observation time. The explicit inverse-square first passage with exponentially initial-coupling-dependent amplitude and an epsilon-dependent logarithmic correction yields a quantitatively interpretable memory effect of finite adaptation. This is a sharp nonlinear delay observable, not a routine Jacobian calculation. No assertion is made for detuning, arbitrary networks or changing epsilon.
